description: This is a Kotlin source file implementing a background worker class for notifications in an Android application. The class 'NotificationWorker' extends CoroutineWorker and retrieves calendar events from a database to display notifications.

classes.name: NotificationWorker
classes.description: A worker class to fetch calendar events for the current date and trigger notifications for each event.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Overridden suspend function that runs in background to fetch today's events and display notifications.
